user create:
Usage of user create:
  -display string
    	Display name
  -email string
    	Email address
  -password string
    	initial password; refused on the command line (process listings expose it) — use --password-file or --password-stdin
  -password-file string
    	0600 regular file containing the initial password
  -password-stdin
    	read the initial password from one stdin line
user password:
Usage of user password:
  -new-password string
    	new password; refused on the command line (process listings expose it) — use --new-password-file or --new-password-stdin
  -new-password-file string
    	0600 regular file containing the new password
  -new-password-stdin
    	read the new password from one stdin line
webhook create:
Usage of webhook create:
  -events string
    	Comma-separated event types
  -url string
    	Destination URL
tls set:
Usage of tls set:
  -challenge string
    	ACME challenge type (tls-alpn-01, http-01, dns-01)
  -dns-provider string
    	DNS provider for dns-01 (cloudflare, route53, rfc2136)
  -domains string
    	Comma-separated domain list
  -email string
    	ACME notification email
schema check:
Usage of schema check:
  -json
    	JSON output
schema apply:
Usage of schema apply:
  -y	skip confirmation (short)
  -yes
    	skip confirmation
sources status:
Usage of sources status:
  -china-registry string
    	approved China Collabora registry/repository
  -collabora-registry string
    	explicit Collabora registry/repository
  -custom-registry string
    	custom Collabora registry/repository
  -isolated-registry string
    	approved local Collabora registry/repository
  -isolated-registry-approved
    	confirm the isolated registry was explicitly approved
  -json
    	machine-readable JSON
  -profile string
    	global, china, isolated, or custom
  -root string
    	host filesystem root (inspection only) (default "/")
